doc.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995

title: Leading a guitar trio with a female singer
summary: Woods asks about the demands of a guitar trio; Johnson says he was too young to know and hired a singer to share the show.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now I want to ask you something about a guitar trio. That is, that really takes some kind of player, because you think of a trio you think of a keyboard player, because he can play chords with his left hand and he can solo with his right hand. So he can kind of comp behind himself. But with you just, what’d you have just bass and drums? That’s a lot of work.

I was too young to know it was a lot of work. I mean you know when I started doing the songs of the day at that time, was “Bet You By Golly Wow” and all that kind of stuff, I didn’t know that was a lot of work.
